mn16:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn16:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn16:2.1: Yassa kassaci bhikkhave bhikkhuno pañca cetokhilā appahīnā, pañca cetaso vinibandhā asamucchinnā, so vat' imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjissatīti n' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
mn16:3.1: Katam' assa pañca cetokhilā appahīnā honti:
mn16:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu Satthari kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati.
mn16:3.3: Yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu Satthari kaṅkhati vicikicchati nādhimuccati na sampasīdati tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya,
mn16:3.4: yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya evam-assāyaṃ paṭhamo cetokhilo appahīno hoti.
mn16:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu dhamme kaṅkhati . . na sampasīdati --pe--
mn16:6.2: Yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu sikkhāya kaṅkhati . . na sampasīdati tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya a. s. p.,
mn16:6.3: yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya a. s. p. evam-assāyaṃ catuttho cetokhilo appahīno hoti.
mn16:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu sabrahmacārisu kupito hoti anattamano āhatacitto khilajāto.

mn16:7.3: yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya a. s. p. evam-assāyaṃ pañcamo cetokhilo appahīno hoti.
